questions.explain: The distance from x to 5 is 2, so x is 2 below or 2 above 5: x = 3 or x = 7.

questions.stem: What is the smallest value of f(x) = |x − 3| + 2?
questions.explain: |x − 3| is smallest (0) at x = 3, so the graph of f has its lowest point at height 2.

questions.stem: What is the straight-line distance between the points (1, 2) and (4, 6)?
questions.explain: The differences are 3 and 4, so the distance is √(9 + 16) = √25 = 5.

questions.stem: What is the mean (centroid) of the points (2, 1), (4, 5) and (6, 3)?
questions.explain: Average each coordinate separately: x = (2 + 4 + 6)/3 = 4 and y = (1 + 5 + 3)/3 = 3.
